Adani Green Energy's 1,500 MW Tarali Pumped Storage Project in Maharashtra's Satara district has landed in controversy after the Forest Department ordered a halt to construction over pending wildlife clearance. The project also faces questions over a proposed reduction in its estimated cost from ₹5,675 crore to ₹56.75 crore, which could significantly reduce the amount allocated for wildlife conservation.
